acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Djinn family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Great Djinn, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Script-Storm Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Giant storm-colored smoke body, jeweled crown, and sacred script written visibly through surrounding vapor.
Signature mechanic: Crowned Clause: the jeweled crown points to one sacred line written in vapor, and the giant body curls around that line until its final glyph closes.
battlefieldDuty: Control alternating script zones through a giant storm-colored body without obscuring the readable binding glyph.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 vapor, half-face, and trailing plume gain an invisible pressure cinch; T2 the defined torso and plain cuffs gain directional channels; T3 visible wind arms and orbiting rings gain calibrated vanes; T4 crown and sacred script gain pressure glyphs; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps gain bounded throne gauges.

Motion/process branches use an additional pressure process with tiered apparatus: T1 the vapor half-face routes its plume around a still cinch; T2 the torso vents through one cuff channel; T3 the wind arms drive orbiting-ring vanes; T4 crown script redirects one pressure glyph; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps drive and still one throne gauge.
counterplay: Cross outside the writing direction and break the final open glyph before the storm body closes around it. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the vapor half-face exposes its still plume-cinch apparatus after the directional rush; T2 the torso cuff opens its still channel after venting; T3 wind arms and orbiting rings expose the vane anchor between releases; T4 crown script exposes the still pressure glyph between clauses; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps expose the throne gauge at its still interval.
forbiddenTreatments: Native hovering or vortex motion alone presented as Wind affinity
identityInvariants: A hovering humanoid upper body tapers into smoke instead of legs; solidity and scale change only at explicit tiers.
Sapphire or violet smoke, warm inner light, gold, brass, turquoise, silk, and gemstones remain distinct source materials.
Cuffs, rings, headpieces, lamps, and script mark proposed binding status without establishing universal culture or morality.
The body becomes less solid and more spatially dominant from half-face vapor to a palace-scale throne vortex.
telegraph: One crown jewel aligns with the floor while sacred script writes outward from the matching smoke shoulder.
